gloss: to writhe, to squirm, to wriggle in agony

definitions.gloss: to writhe (in pain), to squirm, to wriggle in agony
definitions.explanation: To twist and move one's whole body intensely due to pain, discomfort, or strong emotion. More emphatic than {悶|もだ}える.

examples.japanese: {激痛|げきつう}に{身悶|みもだ}える
{彼|かれ}は{苦|くる}しさに{身悶|みもだ}えしていた。
{恥|は}ずかしさで{身悶|みもだ}えするほどの{失敗|しっぱい}をした。
examples.english: I made such an embarrassing mistake that I wanted to squirm.

notes:
FORMATION: Compound of {身|み} (body) + {悶|もだ}える (to writhe). The prefix {身|み} emphasizes the involvement of the whole body.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}).

CONJUGATION: Ichidan verb: {身悶|みもだ}えない, {身悶|みもだ}えます, {身悶|みもだ}えて.

USAGE: Often used figuratively for emotional distress (embarrassment, frustration) where one metaphorically wants to writhe.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {痛|いた}み/{苦|くる}しみに{身悶|みもだ}える (to writhe in pain/agony)
- {恥|は}ずかしさに{身悶|みもだ}える (to squirm with embarrassment)
- {身悶|みもだ}えするほど (to the point of writhing)

RELATED WORDS:
- {悶|もだ}える (to writhe - less emphatic)
- のたうち{回|まわ}る (to roll around in agony)
- {身|み}をよじる (to twist one's body)
